title: GapAsks
description: Record of which documentation gaps were actually PUT TO THE PATIENT, when, through what channel, and what came back (references/gap-followup.md). It is the memory that stops the archive asking for the same missing discharge summary every session — and, more importantly, the memory that stops 「patient said they don't have it」 from decaying into 「the document does not exist」. Three hard limits. (1) It is a FOLLOW-UP LOG, not a clinical checklist: the inventory of which documents are missing lives in missing_items.json, and nothing here may be read as evidence that a test or procedure is indicated. (2) `declined` records a patient's answer, never a judgement about it — a declined ask is closed, not escalated, and never re-asked without a new reason. (3) It is not a source library: no structured output may cite it and no fact may rest on it, because an ask is a question, not a reading of any document.

document_category.description: WHICH class of document was asked for, in the archive's own category wording (e.g. 「出院小结」, 「病理报告」) — matching the missing_items.json row it follows up. A category, never a specific test recommendation and never a named institution.

asked_at.description: When the ask was made. It carries the date for the same reason every archived fact does: an unanswered ask from eight months ago and one from yesterday are different situations.

channel.description: How the ask reached the patient/caregiver. `clinician_request` marks a gap a clinician asked for, which is the one case the item may be surfaced to a clinician-facing view; every other channel is organizing-side follow-up.

outcome.description: `pending` = asked, nothing back yet — the only state that justifies re-asking, and only after a sensible interval. `answered` = the material arrived and was ingested (the sidecar/inventory row is the proof, not this file). `declined` = the patient said no, or said they do not have it. A declined ask is CLOSED: it is not escalated, not re-asked without a new reason, and never converted into 「this document does not exist」 on any patient-facing surface.

source_id.description: When outcome is answered: the source_id in source_inventory.json that the ask produced, so the loop is closeable from either end.

note.description: Short, factual follow-up note. Never a characterization of the patient's cooperation.
